question: Which vitamin deficiency in the diet causes Korsakoff syndrome, a chronic memory disorder that damages your brain?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Thiamine__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Korsakoff Syndrome : **It's a** chronic neuropsychiatric syndrome **caused by **deficiency of thiamine, or vitamin B1**.
 
• The deficiency leads to **damage to multiple areas of the brain**, which in turn cause** amnesia **and** confusion**.
 
• Often connected with alcoholism</stron
